title: The family's account, and the papers in question

shots.direction: HOOK (0-5 s): talking close-up of Nia at the reading-room table, two thin folders and a typed statement in front of her.

lines.en: Bore da. How far back can we follow Tŷ Mawr on paper? Today we sort what we hold from what we're still chasing.
lines.cy: Bore da. Pa mor bell yn ôl allwn ni ddilyn Tŷ Mawr ar bapur? Heddiw, rydyn ni'n gwahanu'r hyn sydd gyda ni oddi wrth yr hyn rydyn ni'n dal i chwilio amdano.
lines.es: Bore da. ¿Hasta dónde podemos seguir Tŷ Mawr en el papel? Hoy separamos lo que tenemos de lo que aún buscamos.

shots.direction: Talking close-up of the Grandson laying the typed statement on the foam cradle.

lines.en: Start with the family's own account. Mary (Nancy) Williams's statement.
lines.cy: Dechreuwch gyda hanes y teulu ei hun. Datganiad Mary (Nancy) Williams.
lines.es: Empecemos por el relato de la propia familia. La declaración de Mary (Nancy) Williams.

shots.direction: Talking close-up of Nia, a gloved finger on the statement.

lines.en: In it she sets down that the Williams family came to Tŷ Mawr in sixteen sixty-seven. That's the family's account, and the Master Timeline lists it that way.
lines.cy: Ynddo mae hi'n nodi bod teulu Williams wedi dod i Dŷ Mawr yn un fil chwe chant chwe deg saith. Dyna hanes y teulu, ac felly mae'r Brif Linell Amser yn ei restru.
lines.es: En ella deja constancia de que la familia Williams llegó a Tŷ Mawr en mil seiscientos sesenta y siete. Ese es el relato de la familia, y así lo recoge la Cronología principal.

shots.direction: Talking close-up of the Grandson, leaning in.

lines.en: And the oldest record that names the house?
lines.cy: A'r cofnod hynaf sy'n enwi'r tŷ?
lines.es: ¿Y el registro más antiguo que nombra la casa?

shots.direction: Talking close-up of Nia, turning a printed catalogue sheet toward him.

lines.en: So far, eighteen twenty-four: David Stewart's survey of the Bute estates, plan nineteen, Cedfin or Tŷ Mawr. We open that next.
lines.cy: Hyd yma, un fil wyth cant dau ddeg pedwar: arolwg David Stewart o ystadau Bute, cynllun pedwar ar bymtheg, Cedfin neu Dŷ Mawr. Fe agorwn ni hwnnw nesaf.
lines.es: Por ahora, mil ochocientos veinticuatro: el levantamiento de David Stewart de las fincas de Bute, plano diecinueve, Cedfin o Tŷ Mawr. Lo abriremos a continuación.

shots.direction: Wordless insert (3 s): two thin family research folders, unlabelled, beside an empty archive box.
Talking close-up of the Grandson, tapping the two folders.

lines.en: What about the older notes in my folders? The long lease of Cydwin, the Bute papers.
lines.cy: Beth am yr hen nodiadau yn fy ffolderi? Y les hir ar Gydwin, papurau Bute.
lines.es: ¿Y las notas antiguas de mis carpetas? El arrendamiento largo de Cydwin, los papeles de Bute.

shots.direction: Talking close-up of Nia, careful and even.

lines.en: They're notes about other people's papers, and nobody here has seen the originals. Whether any of them touches Tŷ Mawr, and whether the Bute freeholds were ever good, is under forensic examination. Until then, they're not Tŷ Mawr records.
lines.cy: Nodiadau am bapurau pobl eraill ydyn nhw, a does neb yma wedi gweld y rhai gwreiddiol. Mae p'un a yw unrhyw un ohonyn nhw'n cyffwrdd â Thŷ Mawr, ac a oedd rhyddfreiniau Bute erioed yn ddilys, dan archwiliad fforensig. Tan hynny, nid cofnodion Tŷ Mawr ydyn nhw.
lines.es: Son notas sobre papeles de otros, y nadie aquí ha visto los originales. Si alguno toca Tŷ Mawr, y si las propiedades de Bute fueron alguna vez válidas, está bajo examen forense. Hasta entonces, no son registros de Tŷ Mawr.

shots.direction: Talking close-up of the Grandson, nodding.

lines.en: So the family's account stands, and those papers have to earn their place.
lines.cy: Felly mae hanes y teulu'n sefyll, ac mae'n rhaid i'r papurau hynny ennill eu lle.
lines.es: Entonces el relato de la familia se mantiene, y esos papeles tienen que ganarse su sitio.

shots.direction: Wordless moving shot (4 s): Nia unrolls large reproduction estate plans across the table and weights the corners with boxes.
Talking close-up of Nia over the plans.

lines.en: And here's company for the search: the Percy Randell collection, estate plans from seventeen eighty-six to eighteen thirty-two, for Cogan, Llandough, Penarth, St Andrews Major and Sully. What they show of Tŷ Mawr, we'll learn field by field.
lines.cy: A dyma gwmni i'r chwilio: casgliad Percy Randell, cynlluniau ystad o un fil saith cant wyth deg chwech hyd un fil wyth cant tri deg dau, ar gyfer Cogan, Llandochau, Penarth, St Andrews Major a Sully. Beth maen nhw'n ei ddangos o Dŷ Mawr, fe ddysgwn ni gae wrth gae.
lines.es: Y aquí hay compañía para la búsqueda: la colección Percy Randell, planos de fincas de mil setecientos ochenta y seis a mil ochocientos treinta y dos, de Cogan, Llandough, Penarth, St Andrews Major y Sully. Lo que muestren de Tŷ Mawr, lo aprenderemos campo a campo.

shots.direction: Wordless drift (5 s) across the Llandough hill over the Ely marsh toward the distant estuary.

continuity: Chronology rule (owner 26 Oct 11:45): Tŷ Mawr first named in the record found so far in 1824 (EV-0211); family account 1667 (CH-0003); third-party papers (EV-0002, EV-0003) are never shown as Tŷ Mawr records and their dates are not spoken (editorial: third-party paper dates are not given in public text). F008 opens the 1824 survey.
